"""Customer support ticket transition workflow."""
from typing import Dict, Set, Any
from errors import ServiceError
from ticket_models import SupportTicket

TICKET_TRANSITIONS: Dict[str, Set[str]] = {
    "CREATED": {"ASSIGNED", "CLOSED"},
    "ASSIGNED": {"IN_PROGRESS", "CLOSED"},
    "IN_PROGRESS": {"RESOLVED", "ASSIGNED"},
    "RESOLVED": {"CLOSED", "IN_PROGRESS"},
    "CLOSED": set(),
}

def transition_ticket(ticket: SupportTicket, next_state: str, actor_id: str, timestamp_ms: int) -> None:
    """Applies status change to support ticket."""
    cur = ticket.state
    if next_state not in TICKET_TRANSITIONS[cur]:
        raise ServiceError("INVALID_TRANSITION", f"Cannot transition from {cur} to {next_state}")
    
    ticket.state = next_state
    ticket.audit_trail.append((cur, next_state, actor_id, timestamp_ms))

def get_ticket_status(ticket: SupportTicket) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    return {"id": ticket.entity_id, "state": ticket.state, "closed": ticket.is_closed()}
=== END ===

from ticket_models import SupportTicket
from ticket_workflow import transition_ticket, get_ticket_status

def test_case_1():
    t = SupportTicket("tick-01")
    # This should fail because RESOLVED is not a valid transition from CREATED
    try:
        transition_ticket(t, "RESOLVED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
        assert False, "Expected INVALID_TRANSITION error"
    except Exception as e:
        assert "INVALID_TRANSITION" in str(e)
        
    # This should work
    transition_ticket(t, "ASSIGNED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.state == "ASSIGNED"
    assert t.audit_count() == 1
    
    # This should also work
    transition_ticket(t, "IN_PROGRESS", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.state == "IN_PROGRESS"
    assert t.audit_count() == 2
    
    # This should work
    transition_ticket(t, "RESOLVED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.state == "RESOLVED"
    assert t.audit_count() == 3
    
    # This should work
    transition_ticket(t, "CLOSED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.state == "CLOSED"
    assert t.audit_count() == 4

from ticket_models import SupportTicket
from ticket_workflow import transition_ticket, get_ticket_status

def test_initial_ticket():
    t = SupportTicket("tick-01")
    assert t.state == "CREATED"
    assert t.audit_count() == 0
    st = get_ticket_status(t)
    assert not st["closed"]

def test_assign():
    t = SupportTicket("tick-01")
    transition_ticket(t, "ASSIGNED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.state == "ASSIGNED"
    assert t.audit_count() == 1

def test_audit_trail():
    t = SupportTicket("tick-01")
    transition_ticket(t, "ASSIGNED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    transition_ticket(t, "IN_PROGRESS", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.audit_count() == 2
    assert t.audit_trail[0] == ("CREATED", "ASSIGNED", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
    assert t.audit_trail[1] == ("ASSIGNED", "IN_PROGRESS", "agent-1", 1700000000000)
